## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

<sub>[context source](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407/blob/04d8a90549d23fc6bd7f642064003592df51e9b3/README.md): Context length stated on the official model card.</sub>

<pre>
download         size  score
4-bit q4_0    ~7.85GB   44.5
4-bit q4_k_m  ~7.85GB   44.5
8-bit q8_0    ~15.2GB   44.5
</pre>

```sh
# 4-bit q4_0
ollama run mistral-nemo:12b
# 4-bit q4_k_m
ollama run mistral-nemo:12b-instruct-2407-q4_K_M
# 8-bit q8_0
ollama run mistral-nemo:12b-instruct-2407-q8_0
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
